matches.title: Accel vs Golden Mini
matches.snippet: I'm sure this has been done about 50 trillion times but I wanted to try myself. matches.title: TDS Hot Take
matches.snippet: Im about to get flamed in the replies. Trapper is the worst tower in tds. Why? It’s because almost every other tower is better. Yes, you might be screaming, “PAINTBALLER”, but paintballer is useful (kinda), as its splash is actually pretty good (you should try it out). Trappers role is a last defense, but in a solo or duo, which I think is the most common way to play (correct me if I’m wrong), using up a tower slot for someone that could be better, e.g. military base, would be bad, as you only have 10 tower slots in duo. Commando is also very bad from what other people said (I don’t own it), but unlike trapper, you don’t buy commando. Trapper is fun to use, but in a solo, most of the time you are better off with another tower. Here’s an example: imagine you want to solo fallen, and this is your loadout: farm, commander, dj, minigunner, and warden. How would you fit trapper into that? If you say paintballer can’t fit, yes it can, as you just replace it with warden. I know trapper can be used for early, but honestly, it sucks. I don’t want to wait 40 seconds just to beat one wave. Disagree with me, but just keep it civil. $4 someone says I’m yapping, as it is 3 am for where I live and I just got this idea.
